gloss: tipping feature; donation function (on a live-streaming or social media platform)

definitions.gloss: tipping feature; donation function (on a live-streaming platform)
definitions.explanation: An online feature that allows viewers to send money to a streamer, creator, or performer in real time while watching or reading their content. Common on live-streaming sites, video platforms, and social media, where it serves as direct viewer-to-creator financial support.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{投|な}げ{銭|せん}→投げ銭：06444_nagesen⟧ (tossing a coin; tip, historically a coin tossed to street performers) and ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧ (function; feature). The original ⟦{投|な}げ{銭|せん}→投げ銭：06444_nagesen⟧ referred to coins thrown to traveling musicians and street performers; the modern digital usage extends this image to online platforms.

USAGE:
A 21st-century tech term. You will see it on service-description pages, news articles about streamers, and in conversations about YouTube, Twitch, niconico, and similar platforms. The ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧ part can be dropped when context is clear — people often just say ⟦{投|な}げ{銭|せん}→投げ銭：06444_nagesen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to receive a tip). On English-language platforms, the feature often has brand names like "Super Chat," "Bits," or "Tips," which in Japanese are grouped under {投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use the tipping feature
- {投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧: to introduce a tipping feature
- ⟦{投|な}げ{銭|せん}→投げ銭：06444_nagesen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send a tip
- ⟦{投|な}げ{銭|せん}→投げ銭：06444_nagesen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}する→応援する：21988_ouensuru⟧: to support (a creator) with tips

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投|な}げ{銭|せん}→投げ銭：06444_nagesen⟧: tip; money tossed to a performer — the base noun, used alone or as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧
- ⟦チップ→チップ：11019_chippu⟧: tip (foreign-style gratuity) — used for tipping in restaurants and services rather than online content
- ⟦スーパーチャット→スーパーチャット：29760_suupaachatto⟧: Super Chat — a specific implementation of {投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう} on YouTube Live
- ⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧: paid usage; in-app purchases — broader concept covering any payment to a service
